about: ERROR.TYPE (docs/specs/exsheet-functions ticket 17; ADR-0047, 2026-10-10). Microsoft's table numbers #NULL! to #N/A from 1 to 7, and anything that is not an error is #N/A. Excel's newer Error Values take the numbers the seventeenth Windows run read from Excel: #SPILL! 9, #CONNECT! 10, #BLOCKED! 11, #UNKNOWN! 12, #FIELD! 13, #CALC! 14. #GETTING_DATA and #CIRC! are given back, never numbered.

cases.description: Microsoft's table: #NULL! is 1 (its example, A2 holding #NULL!)
Microsoft's table: #DIV/0! is 2
Microsoft's table: #VALUE! is 3
Microsoft's table: #REF! is 4
Microsoft's table: #NAME? is 5 (a function nobody declared)
Microsoft's table: #NUM! is 6
Microsoft's table: #N/A is 7
Microsoft's table: a number, which is no error, is #N/A
Microsoft's table: text, which is no error, is #N/A
Microsoft's example: ERROR.TYPE of #DIV/0! chooses its message with CHOOSE

cells.ZZ1000: =IF(ERROR.TYPE(A3)<3,CHOOSE(ERROR.TYPE(A3),"Ranges do not intersect","The divisor is zero"))

cases.description: Engine's answer, Excel to be asked: a blank cell, which is no error, is #N/A
Engine's answer, Excel to be asked: a boolean, which is no error, is #N/A
Excel's number for #SPILL! typed into a cell is 9 (typed with real keys in the seventeenth Windows run)
cases.oracleSkip: Range.FormulaLocal keeps this as text, but typed with real keys Excel reads the Error Value (verification/2026-10-11-windows-17); ask by keys

cases.description: #SPILL! from a spill with an Entry in its way is 9, as Excel numbers it
#CALC! from a FILTER that keeps nothing is 14, as Excel numbers it

cases.description: ERROR.TYPE over a cycle is #CIRC!, given back rather than numbered
cases.engineDiffersByDecision: ADR-0047: a Formula that reads a cycle member is #CIRC!, where Excel shows 0 in it, as in the cycle's own cells, whatever the Formula would compute from the 0 it reads (the seventeenth Windows run)

cases.description: ERROR.TYPE over a range of several cells, where one Value is wanted, is refused
cases.engineDiffersByDecision: ADR-0125: functions are not lifted over arrays yet; an array where the function wants one Value is #VALUE!, where Excel 365 lifts it and spills

cases.description: ERROR.TYPE does not number a refused cell's #VALUE!: B1 is MROUND(0.35,0.1), refused, which Excel answered 0.4 (MROUND-004); what ERROR.TYPE(B1) gives is asked
cases.engineDiffersByDecision: ADR-0047 (2026-10-12, decided with the user: a refusal is never caught, anywhere): MROUND's fractional multiple is refused (ADR-0047), and a Formula that reads the refused cell is refused, where ERROR.TYPE gave 3 before
